conviction_note: The release carries the final Q1 statement, whose numbers came out on 27 Aug, plus Q2/H1 preliminary numbers the market has not seen (the issuer's calendar lists a 15:00 CEST call), so the size is set on new numbers at 6.0. The direction is only slightly positive (p_up 54): Röhrig's AOC fund bought €12.4m in the 30 days before the print, and there has been no ad-hoc since the June guidance cut, which argues against a cut. Against that, the tilt matches the already-positive lean (+3.18) and the covering shorts, and H1 free cash flow and leverage above 5x are a Luceco-style downside line. print_vs_bar is 0 because the guide was reset after Q2 closed and was reaffirmed on 27 Aug.

already_public.what: Preliminary Q1 2026 (Dec-Feb): revenue EUR 524m, adj. EBITDA EUR 66m (12.6% margin vs 15.7%), FCF EUR -32m; 'stronger second half ... in line with its guidance'. The 30 Sep Q1 statement finalises these numbers
FY2026 guidance cut by ad-hoc: revenue in lower half of EUR 2.3-2.4bn, adj. EBITDA margin ~17-18% (from 18-19%), FCF EUR -50 to -100m (from moderately positive). Set after Q2 (Mar-May) had closed
Sale of Centor + Primary Packaging Plastics to Apax funds at ~EUR 1.5bn EV; Centor closing by end FY2026, PPP in H1 FY2027; refinancing after the PPP closing
Q1 call: guidance 'intact', Q1 'the low point of the year', Centor closing expected November 2026
Leverage covenants waived through Q3 FY2026; promissory-note (EUR 870m) and bank extension for delivery of audited 2025 accounts to 30 Sep 2026 (accounts delivered 29 Jun)

new_in_release.expect: Q2 (Mar-May 2026) preliminary revenue and adj. EBITDA, never disclosed. Management called Q1 the low point, so expect a sequential margin recovery from 12.6%, probably still below the 17-18% FY band, and roughly on the path the June reset implies. Direction vs the market's own number: unknown, slight tilt to in-line

Most likely reiterated. There has been no ad-hoc since 29 Jun although Q2 closed 31 May and Q3 closed 31 Aug, and a board-linked buyer bought in September. A cut is the left tail, given this issuer's run of warnings in 2025
H1 FCF and net debt against the FY FCF guide of EUR -50 to -100m and leverage above 5x: the one line that can sink an in-line print (Luceco pattern). Direction unknown, modestly negative risk

Possible news on Centor closing, a covenant waiver for Q4, or a CEO appointment. Retail expects Centor with the numbers, but management guided November, so its absence should not matter to institutions

findings.finding: Active Ownership Opportunities SCS, a closely associated person of new supervisory board member Klaus Röhrig, bought about EUR 12.4m of Gerresheimer stock on Xetra between 1 and 11 Sep 2026 at EUR 27.42-28.92. That is inside the 30 days before the 30 Sep Q2/H1 preliminary results, whose quarter closed 31 May and whose numbers the board has. Together with no ad-hoc since the 29 Jun guidance cut, this argues against a guidance cut or a materially negative Q2 on 30 Sep.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Events that brought the reporting back to normal have been bought even when the numbers were bad: 29 Jun guidance cut plus audited accounts +5.93%, 29 Jul Apax sale +6.18% (opened about +17%), 27 Aug Q1 preliminary miss (EBITDA -19% y/y) +4.41%. The one pure governance shock, the interim CEO exit on 24 Aug, fell -8.71% (Yahoo daily bars, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/GXI.DE?range=6mo&interval=1d)

findings.why_not_priced: The filings are public, but the stock has since fallen from EUR 29.84 (7 Sep) to 26.04 (25 Sep), below every AOC purchase price. If the market read these trades as a board-linked 'no bad news' signal on a print whose quarter had already closed, the price would not have drifted below the insider's cost into the event. English coverage frames AOC as an activist building a stake, not as an insider in the pre-results window. The positive lean (+3.18) comes from the short register, not from this.

baseline_tension: It agrees with the positive lean (+3.18, driven by a 5.38% short that is slowly covering) and with the +3.4% five-day run-up, so it adds little beyond positioning. That is why p_up is held at 54 and the sum at +0.5.
language_note: Only the German press (boersennews, 28 Sep) noted that the mandatory notice names just the final Q1 statement while the issuer's calendar also lists preliminary Q2/H1 results with a 15:00 CEST call. So the release carries genuinely new numbers, which sets abs_move at the new-numbers base rather than the ~3% pre-released base. The English EQS wire only says 'Quarterly financial report ... (Q1)'

The German retail press reads the absence of any follow-up Prognose ad-hoc since June as a positive signal, and says retail expects Centor's closing alongside the numbers (so its absence is a small disappointment risk). Neither point appeared in the English sources

The German aggregators carried the AI-generated '870 Mio. bis 30. September' refinancing-deadline story, which the April ad-hoc shows to be a misreading. The German side added noise here as well as signal
lessons_applied: 'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): H1 FCF and leverage are a separate downside line on an issuer with net debt around 5x and a negative FCF guide, so p_up went from 56 to 54 and the finding from +0.7 to +0.5

'Positioning is the thing to beat, not agree with': the finding's direction matches the +3.18 lean and the covering shorts, which is another reason for the trim; abs_move_pct stays at 6.0 per 'size the move on what is new, let history move p_up'
